case_number: Civil Appeal Nos. ______ of 2023 [Arising out of SLP (Civil) Nos. 22021-22022 of 2022]

parties.petitioner: M/S. South Indian Bank Ltd. & Ors.

summary: Private financial transactions vs SARFAESI enforcement; writ maintainability under Article 226 questioned; effective alternative remedy via DRT established; High Court interference improper post-Tribunal revival; one-time settlement terms unilaterally modified; dismissal of criminal acquittal irrelevant to departmental proceedings; deferred payment direction set aside; settled law reiterated on writ jurisdiction limits in commercial recovery cases.
legal_provisions_cited: Hari Vishnu Kamath v. Syed Ahmad Ishaque (1955) SCR 1104
final_judgment: Appeals allowed in part; High Court orders permitting deferred payments quashed; private financial disputes barred from writ jurisdiction when DRT functional; SARFAESI enforcement restored.
